description: This file contains shell script code for testing Git sparse checkout behavior, including setup, branch creation, sparse checkout configuration, merging, and cloning with partial fetches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies Git configuration values.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository, optionally with specific options.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for differences.
